# 1.2.121 - the audit's majors: a masked killer's name kept hidden on every road, the veil at the Eclipse and on the camera dock, a hidden defence in a crisis, windows that redraw at once while you type, Room and Season setup that follow the world, a release that reuses its green CI run, and two fixes to 1.2.120

One stage ships: E121 (tools/stages.json): the open major findings of the audit of 1.2.118, re-read on 1.2.119
(audit/findings-1.2.118/recheck-119.json), built by six lines (M1, M2, K, R1, R2, I), two fixes to 1.2.120 found by the
audit's check of that release (AUDIT 18.6), and the audit's own branch. **E39, E40, E43, E53, E58 and E83 are not
shipped**, planned 1.2.123. E26 stays 1.3.0. From 03ee8de9 (main at 1.2.120, tag v1.2.120) to
21bf5d18, the assembly's last commit before this release commit: 165 commits, 14 of them merges of the lines and the audit's
branch into the assembly (`git rev-list --count` and `--merges --count`; the lines' own commits are counted, as they
began before 1.2.120's tag).

In plain words. Everything below is read off the code and the headless harness; none of it has run on a real Foundry or
at a table (## Checked).

**Two fixes to 1.2.120** (the audit's check of 1.2.120, AUDIT 18.6).
- A click on the planner's Move, a "Rests on" box or Add deduction right after typing in a field works the first time
  again: a field's change no longer let go of a press on a button (live.mjs: a `change` ends the hold only when it comes
  from the control being pressed; line P, the audit's r120-P-1, a regression of 1.2.120; R8012).
- Move under By room, By state or Fewer crossings no longer reorders the other columns (investigation.mjs; line P,
  r120-P-2).
- The fog no longer leaves a player's map uncovered after a fade was cut short in a background or slow tab; the fade now
  finishes drawing the new fog before it is let go (fog.mjs: a dissolve held past its bound runs its own end once; line F,
  the audit's r120-F-1, a regression of 1.2.120; R8032).

**A masked killer's name** (line M1; the audit's CORE-20, N119-1 to N119-4).
- A masked killer's name stays "?" for players outside the mask after it ends, until the killer reveals themselves,
  also when a second GM who was away serves a card's words or rewrites it (secret.mjs; scenario 97 phase K).
- A Monocub's Ghost Bet and a Bounty placed on a masked student read "?" on the Monocub's panel and cards until the
  killer reveals themselves (monocub.mjs `forgetMaskedTarget`).
- A room action used beside a killer veiled for the opening no longer names them to its user (facilities-gm.mjs).

**The veil and the masks at the Eclipse, the chapter's end and the camera dock** (line M2; the audit's DOC-01, STG-03,
COMM-20).
- A Direct Murder declared in an Eclipse no longer hides its killer when the lights cancel it: a killer who stands alone
  or with witnesses is never hidden, and one refused at the lights is shown again at once (eclipse.mjs, mask-gm.mjs
  `liftAtTheLights`).
- End the chapter's next morning ends any mask before the day's boards play (clock.mjs `writesBoardStamp`;
  R7930).
- With the voice tile off, Foundry's camera dock shows "?" for every name on the tile of a killer the veil or a mask
  hides from you (camera-view.mjs `relabelCameraDock`; R7931, scenario 21). What avclient-livekit's own box shows is not
  read (LIVE-F119-03).

**The murder's rules** (line K; the audit's CASE-16, CASE-17, CASE-18, STG-01; CASE-16 is the owner's option 1).
- A victim or third who cannot see the killer (behind a "?", or in a trap) is told "Beat N + a hidden defense" on the
  crisis row and in the roll window, and their result card says hit or miss without the GM's number. The GM still
  judges with the killer's statistic (murder-rules.mjs `crisisDefenseHidden`, `crisisDc`; R7950).
- A clean-up's fresh-scene discount is read off the document the game scores (cleanup.mjs), a Keep Watch's hindrance die
  holds for a murder declared in the dark (watch-gm.mjs `holdForTheLights`; the incident's new GM-only `watchDie`), and
  a trace two students find at once gets one description (observe.mjs `createFind`).

**Windows that redraw at once** (line R1; the owner's rule "Zawsze odswiezamy okna od razu przy zmianie"; the audit's
UI-17, REFR-01, REFR-05).
- Every window that keeps itself current now redraws at once even while you type or have a field focused, keeping your
  text, caret and focus: a select never holds a redraw (live.mjs `keepLive`, `whileEditing` now on by default; R7970,
  R7972-R7974). The Sound window's Music rows show another GM's mapping while a row's select keeps the focus.
- A GM's Remnant card and the Mastermind's Give Hope box redraw while you type, keeping what you typed.
- The Mastermind window follows another GM's change of the Mastermind, and Give Hope always goes to the Mastermind
  named at the moment you press it (or says none is set) (mastermind.mjs; the audit's F-6 on 1.2.120).
- The Notice history lists a new notice at once wherever you are in it, keeping your place; the pill takes you up to
  what is new.

**Room setup and Season setup** (line R2; the audit's REFR-02 in part, REFR-03, REFR-04, N119-7).
- Room setup follows the map while it is open (locks forced, stashes, rooms found, rooms drawn or deleted, the students),
  keeps what the GM has typed, and its Apply writes only what the GM changed, so a lock forced or a Repair the Lock
  started meanwhile is no longer undone (room-setup.mjs; R7990).
- Room setup keeps a search-token count the GM is typing when the window redraws; the count is sent only when the GM
  leaves the field or presses - or +.
- Season setup, Edit campaign and the Season checklist follow the clock and the safeword also on a world's first write of
  them; the checklist's count and the rows that come and go follow too (gm-campaign.mjs `followCampaignFields`,
  season-setup.mjs `relistRows`; R7991).

**Releases** (line I; the owner's decision "A", 21.11.2026).
- A release no longer runs CI a second time: when a green CI run of the exact same tree already ran every part (usually
  the release PR's head), release.yml reuses it, names it in the summary, and skips about 40 minutes. Otherwise CI runs
  as before (audit/gate/reuse-ci.mjs; 21 cases in verify-gate's self-test).

## Before installing

- **No migration step** (scripts/migrate.mjs has no change). No setting is added or removed (`game.settings.register` on
  202 lines of scripts/ at both ends); settings.mjs has no change. **One GM store changes its definition**: the
  incident's cast gains `watchDie` (gm-stores.mjs), the GMs' alone and null in every player's copy; an incident written
  before this release has none, and reads the running watch as before.
- **Language**: lang/en.json goes from 6409 to 6413 keys: 4 added (`DRPG.Murder.thresholdHidden`, `.dcHidden`,
  `.scoreHidden.hit`, `.scoreHidden.miss`), none removed, none changed. lang/pl.json goes from 7506 to 7510, the same 4
  added. Counted on the flattened files, 03ee8de9 against this tree.
- No glyph added (icons/pixel-sprite.svg and tools/glyphs.json have no change). No console name changed
  (tools/api-surface.json has no change in the range).
- **Daggerheart**: `verified` stays 2.12.9. **Foundry**: module.json's compatibility has no change (minimum 14.364,
  verified 14.365); the owner's sandbox runs 14.370, which module.json does not name.

## Known gaps

- **Not shipped**: E39, E40, E43, E53, E58 and E83 (tools/stages.json, planned 1.2.123). E26 stays 1.3.0.
- **The rest of the audit is for 1.2.122**: among them Stained Glass high contrast drawing no icon for a hidden or locked
  token and a focus ring cut off (H-1, H-7), no road in the module to Daggerheart's conditions (H-2), a counter line that
  runs back across nodes on the Map (P-4), the controls that still wait for Save, Edit campaign's values fixed at the
  press while `applyCampaignForm` asks (REFR-02's rest), the crisis menu's refresh, and the two veil predicates
  (mask-gm.mjs `veiledFromHere`, visibility.mjs `voiceVeiledHere`).
- **A select opened with the keyboard** (Alt+Down) and a redraw: whether the redraw closes it is not read (jsdom draws no
  open list; LIVE-R121-01 b).
- **What avclient-livekit's own box shows** for a hidden killer is not read (LIVE-F119-03 stays open).
- **No local gate has passed**: E121 declares sockets, rolls and scenes, so the gate is required, and no part of it has
  run on this release's tree; audit/gate/local-gate.json says every part not run for want of a server. Nothing in this
  release has run on a real Foundry or at a table.
- **Tier 2 at a table is not green**: line L1's last whole run of tier 2 on the owner's 14.370 sandbox, at d5907e1b,
  read 1326 passed, 214 failed, 26 skipped of 1566 (docs/dev/e58/LOCAL-REPORT.md); no whole run since, on any Foundry.
- **Carried, not closed**: the 11 rows of audit/harness/known-leaks.json, as at 1.2.120. The rest of 1.2.120's list
  stands as its notes give it.
